title: Abbott-Smith, A Manual Greek Lexicon of the New Testament
author: G. Abbott-Smith (1922)
edition: STEPBible “Translators Brief lexicon of Extended Strongs for Greek” (Tyndale House Cambridge), CC BY 4.0 — Abbott-Smith’s definitions edited to the extended Strong’s numbering; a few words lack an Abbott-Smith entry and carry a Middle Liddell or STEPBible definition
rightsNote: Abbott-Smith (1922) is public domain; the STEPBible edition is CC BY 4.0 — credit STEPBible.org and Tyndale House, refer readers to github.com/STEPBible as the source, and note any changes. Extended numbers (a letter after the number) distinguish senses and homonyms; Wellspring shows every entry under the base Strong’s number.
citation: Abbott-Smith, A Manual Greek Lexicon of the New Testament (1922); STEPBible/Tyndale House edition, CC BY 4.0.
